profile.name: Joe Albert Ngigi
profile.title: Mechatronics & Automation Engineer
profile.tagline: Mechatronics & Automation Engineer WorldSkills Lyon 2024 Champion · PLC/SCADA · Robotics · Embedded IoT
profile.bio: Mechatronics engineer with hands-on experience across industrial automation, robotics, and embedded IoT systems. WorldSkills Lyon 2024 international champion and Kenya's 2023 national gold medalist in Mechatronics, with a track record of turning complex technical problems into safe, reliable, well-documented solutions.

bullets: Monitor, calibrate, and maintain critical plant instrumentation (pressure, temperature, and level transmitters), ensuring accurate readings across manometers, thermometers, and digital indicators.
Troubleshoot and repair plant electrical panels, replacing faulty contactors, transformers, fuses, and relays to restore functionality with minimal downtime.
Inspect critical assets in MV/HV rooms and the HV substation using multimeters, frequency meters, capacitance meters, DC sources, and oscilloscopes for precise circuit diagnostics.
Diagnose and repair automated control circuits, sensors, and pneumatic/hydraulic actuators, valves, and motors.
Enforce plant safety compliance through rigorous Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures and rapid emergency response to protect personnel and equipment.
Analyze operational data trends to help the engineering team predict failures and optimize plant performance.
Contributed to a 24K-hour Preventive Maintenance Service (PMS) cycle on a 16 MW generator, including testing and calibration of SIPROTEC protection relays.
Manage inventory and lifecycle tracking of electrical tools/materials and provide internal IT network support.
Programmed and optimized an xArm 7 for high-precision human-robot collaborative (HRC) tasks in shared industrial workspaces.
Refined motion planning and safety parameters to enable seamless human-robot interaction.
Designed synchronized human-robot task workflows that improved operational efficiency and ergonomic safety.
Collaborated on integrating Augmented Reality (AR) tools for real-time task visualization and operator awareness.
Led testing and validation of collaborative robotics scenarios.
Deliver IoT and embedded software projects for clients worldwide using ESP32, Arduino, and Raspberry Pi.
Build cloud-connected dashboards and firmware with MQTT, Node-RED, and Firebase; maintain consistently high client
ratings.
Designed and led an interactive Flutter course for kids, building a full curriculum from UI design through deployment.
Increased student engagement by 50% through hands-on, project-based teaching.
Guided students in building STM32-based line-tracking robots and a 5-DOF robotic arm.
Taught embedded systems fundamentals through hands-on STM32CubeIDE lessons.

education.details:
Selected for a 6-month project-based academic exchange covering AI, automation, and web development. Co-developed CESI Eats, a food delivery platform prototype, and modeled a 3D gluing automation system using AR-assisted
layout optimization.

projects.title: Sorting and Distributing Station
projects.description: A fully automated industrial sorting system designed to detect and classify workpieces by material and color—categorizing black and pink items as plastic, and standard components as metal. Programmed using TIA Portal V17, the solution integrates robust PLC logic with an intuitive HMI interface for real-time control, status monitoring, and diagnostic oversight. Built on core principles of mechatronics and sensor integration, it delivers an efficient, reliable solution for modern automated manufacturing.
